roster.name: Intake reader
roster.job: Reads the photo, PDF or typed request; quotes every amount and date; names the document

roster.name: Case matcher
roster.job: Says who this is about and which skill applies, looking the household up

roster.name: Planner
roster.job: Proposes actions from the matched skill's rules; never sends, pays or files

roster.name: Authority
roster.job: Checks every proposal against the ledger in code; can send the plan back

roster.name: Executor
roster.job: Runs only allowed actions through the rails and returns receipts

roster.name: Briefer
roster.job: Tells the member what happened and what is waiting on whom, in their language
